decisive_items: bilateral adrenal masses that were nonenhancing with an attenuation of 50 HU
response.rationale: Acute abdominal pain with nonenhancing bilateral adrenal masses of 50 HU in a patient with polycythemia vera (thrombotic/hemorrhagic risk) favors adrenal hemorrhage over infarction; pheochromocytoma and metastasis typically enhance or have different clinical context.

rejected.why: Pheochromocytoma usually enhances and presents with paroxysmal hypertension; imaging nonenhancing low attenuation is atypical.
Adrenal infarction is possible but hemorrhage is more common in polycythemia vera with acute pain and nonenhancing masses; infarction less specific.
Metastatic disease would typically show enhancement or heterogeneous lesions; no primary malignancy or enhancing features.
